algorithm.candidate_removal_authority: an edge is removed only after the exact reduced dependency-curried target is independently accepted by the Python kernel
algorithm.final_leave_one_out: the terminal no-removal pass is the leave-one-out observation for every retained candidate dependency
algorithm.fixed_point: repeat complete reverse-order passes until one complete pass removes no dependency

canonical_json.document: UTF-8; keys sorted; two-space indentation; one final LF
canonical_json.hash_preimage: UTF-8; keys sorted; compact separators; no final LF
canonical_json.numbers: exact integers only; booleans are not integers
canonical_json.objects: duplicate keys forbidden; cycles and non-JSON values forbidden
canonical_json.strings: Unicode scalar text; invalid UTF-8 and non-JSON constants forbidden

claim_boundary.authority: candidate dependency-audit observations only; this document cannot admit a theorem, freeze an epoch, or publish a graph
claim_boundary.best_known: false; the retained submitted certificate has no separately retained optimizer program or Pareto comparison
claim_boundary.failed_omission: failure of the exact retained tactic recipe after omitting one dependency is not mathematical necessity, theorem-level minimality, or a negative theoremhood result
claim_boundary.kernel: only a successful independently checked dependency-curried proof is positive evidence; tactics, minimization, source reconstruction, hashing, and receipt construction are untrusted
claim_boundary.metadata: metadata v1 and v2 are immutable inputs; this sidecar does not fill or alter their pending fields
claim_boundary.minimality: minimality_claim is always false; candidate vectors are fixed-point observations for one exact recipe only
claim_boundary.optimized_construction: the current retained certificate and its declared construction vector remain submitted-not-best-known; a smaller candidate vector requires a later certificate rebuild
claim_boundary.publication_union: candidate_publication_union is a deterministic proposal only and has publication_ready=false
claim_boundary.repository_snapshot: repository commit/tree identify the retained theorem and replay inputs; the later A2 dependency compiler is separately bound by fixed_inputs.dependency_compiler and is not claimed to belong to that historical tree
claim_boundary.selection: exactly the retained replay-pack 384 rows in manifest order, joined to the isolated selected documentation API and exact pinned TheoremSpec sources
claim_boundary.use: training, retrieval, evaluation, freeze, publication, review, and owner authority are all false
